name: Sophie's Ten Wishes
source:
Your quiet life is good enough… or is it? A Vegas getaway changes everything – discover love and become the best version of yourself, against all odds.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sophie%27s_Ten_Wishes]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
你平静的生活已经足够好了……是吗？拉斯维加斯之旅改变了一切——发现爱情，克服一切困难，成为最好的自己。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sophie%27s_Ten_Wishes]romance-club.fandom[/url]
